classification: maintenance duplicate stock unit mass/membership authority; current four definitions agree
title: Forge stock unit masses and measured-stock roster duplicate catalogue and stock membership
earliest_failed_contract: One whole stock unit has a physical catalogue weight, a separately hardcoded ForgeStock.unit_mass_kg used to convert material mass to consumable fractions, and an independently written SMITHING_MATERIAL_IDS list controlling whether its per-row fraction exists. These maintain the same current unit identity/mass across distinct internal authorities.
current_comparison: Current Steel5kg, Leather2kg, Brass2kg, Wood4kg exactly match content/items/catalog.yaml1–43 and ForgeStock.unit_mass_kg19–24. Core build embeds these authored records; Core.catalog overrides physical weight only for melee weapons, not Ingredient stock. Native project_definition copies catalogue weight. All four ForgeStock item ids currently appear in measured roster1118:10–11. No present wrong quote/consumption asserted.
counterexample: If authored stock weight changes alone, an item whole projected at that new mass is still converted by old ForgeStock mass into required micros; the native forge then consumes fractions using only the stale quoted count, so same physical requested material can cost a wrong fraction of current stock mass. If a new ForgeStock member/item is admitted but measured roster omitted, quote can select it while amount-state initialization/classification may omit it and availability cannot satisfy normal consume. These are source maintenance divergence scenarios, not executed current failures.
actual_recipient: Core quote_weapon33–46 divides actual generated material kg by independent stock unit mass; native forge_weapon97–105 checks and consumes these fixed-point requirements. InventoryItemAmount explicitly represents one stable unit as WHOLE and stock membership comes from separately authored list. Item table carries catalogue unit weight.
qualification: Related root M81 concerns stock identity erasure and separately mutable quote mass/requirement maps; this is separate exact canonical mass and measured membership authority support. M01 physical quantities applies without automatic alias. Material forge_stock authoring subset intentionally excludes unsupported traded materials; no requirement to trade every material. Equality tests may detect drift but do not remove independent definitions. Current values coherent.
connected_repair: Choose one low shared ForgeStock identity/member/unit-mass authority that catalogue projection/validation, quotation and measured-inventory classification consume; preserve real content/hashing/DB boundaries and architectural dependency direction. Derive stock membership instead of manual parallel list. Coordinate with M81 collection/quantity remedy, not duplicate enum or compatibility API.
acceptance: Existing four stock ids, weights, grouping, required ceil-per-material-before-shared-sum, micros splitting and external map order remain unchanged; edits cannot silently redefine one stock unit differently for inventory mass and forge fractions. No new tests/checks/DB execution in audit.
